title: Jay-6 Plan
summary: Project plan and decision log for Jay-6: browser app translating J-6-style chord pad clicks into MIDI output for the OP-1, scoped across milestones M1-M10 and Phases 2-3.
scope: Roland J-6 chord bank data (100 banks x 12 chords)
notes: Hybrid document: dominant signal is PRD (milestones M1-M10 with acceptance checklists, goals, scope in/out, status table, Phase 2/3 roadmap). Also contains a substantial embedded decision log (Closed/Open/Resolved-during-build) with many small project decisions and a tech-stack section with concrete data shapes. No single architectural decision dominates, so ADR is not the best fit; SPEC signals (data shapes, MIDI channel/port specifics) are subordinate to the requirements/roadmap framing. Per ambiguity rule, decision-log content is acknowledged but PRD wins on volume and framing. Embedded decisions may warrant separate ADR extraction downstream.
